# EndType

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Types](Language-Features-Types)

</div>


```blitzbasic
End Type
EndType
```

## Description

Ends a `Type` declaration. `End Type` and `EndType` mean the same thing.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Type Box
	Field w%
EndType
b.Box = New Box
b\w = 3
Print b\w
```

```text
3
```
